description.en: The ID of the HBR client.
The ID of the resource group.
The ID of the backup vault.

descriptions.zh: 调用该接口会卸载指定的HBR备份客户端，若要重新安装，请调用CreateClients接口。
descriptions.en: If you call this operation, the specified HBR client is uninstalled. To reinstall the HBR client, call the CreateClients operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr uninstall-client --vault-id v-0008n2q000000ax3 --client-id c-000iuqo000000zi3rn --resource-group-id rg-acfm3erpwweavki --region cn-hangzhou
